title: Build API Manager desktop workspace with local storage
body:
API Manager is a Windows desktop REST/SOAP client that needs no application account. Requests, collections, environments, globals, cookies, response history, and tab/editor sessions stay locally and resume after closing the app.

This implements the first desktop release:
- Postman-style collections and nested folders, scrolling tabs, Monaco editors, dark/light themes, and local workspace backup/recovery.
- Postman collection/environment/globals import and export, cURL import/export, scoped variables, and 125 dynamic variables.
- HTTP body modes and file uploads, SOAP 1.1/1.2, every current Postman authorization category, and OAuth token acquisition.
- Isolated pre-request/post-response scripts with assertions, console output, and the latest 200 request/response history entries with replay.
- Response beautification, wrap/unwrap, zoom/reset, copy body with or without headers, and JSON downloads with or without headers.
- A complete installation and feature guide, examples, a dynamic-variable reference, and Windows installer/portable CI artifacts.

Validation: TypeScript and production build passed; 196 Vitest tests and 55 native engine tests passed; all 8 scenarios passed against the final packaged executable across the full run and targeted reruns. Installer and portable builds succeeded. npm audit reported 0 known vulnerabilities. Artifact checksums and detailed coverage are in docs/verification.md.

This is a feature-rich REST/SOAP release, with the remaining compatibility limits documented in README.md: no cloud/team service, collection runner, WebSocket/gRPC client, full Postman scripting SDK, automatic OAuth browser callback, or WSDL operation generation. Local credentials are plain workspace data, and Windows builds are unsigned.
